map.输入囊胚扩张度（1–6 期）、内细胞团 ICM 与滋养外胚层 TE 评级，工具按: Enter blastocyst expansion (1-6), inner cell mass ICM and trophectoderm TE grades; the tool gives blastocyst grade by Gardner system and maps implantation potential, helping ART labs select embryos.
map.：编码 4AA：ICM 与 TE 均 A 级，优质囊胚，优先移植/冷冻。: : Code 4AA: ICM and TE both A grade, high-quality blastocyst, prioritize transfer/freezing.
map.：3BB：可用胚胎，着床潜能中等，可作次选。: : 3BB: usable embryo, medium implantation potential, can be a secondary choice.
map.扩张度(1–6)＋内细胞团(A–C)＋滋养层(A–C)；数字越大越扩张、字母越前: Expansion (1-6) + inner cell mass (A-C) + trophectoderm (A-C); larger number means more expanded, earlier letter means better.
map.扩张≥4 且 ICM/TE 为 A 或 B 的囊胚着床率最高。: Blastocysts with expansion ≥4 and ICM/TE of A or B have the highest implantation rate.
